Grammar extra
Making uncountable nouns countable
Uncountable nouns are often names of materials or of groups of things.You can use a piece of to
jewelry/furniture/music/equipment/information/software/advice/evidence.
Can I give you a piece of advice? When you buy a new piece of equipment, check the warranty.
With some uncountable nouns,you need to use a different countable noun to refer to an example
My job includes a lot of international travel. I go on nine or ten business trips a year.
My boss's feedback is very valuable. Her comments are always useful.
Commonerrors
Use (How much with uncountable nouns and (How many with plural countable nouns.
Don't take too much luggage /too many bags. (NOT. ..too many luggages)
How much travel / How many trips are you planning? (NOT How many travels .. .

piece of, or piece of if necessary. Some have more than one answer.

More about uncountable nouns
Academic subjects and sports that end in -s are usually singular:economics,genetics,
mathematics,physics,politics;aerobics,gymnastics.News also takes a singular verb.
Physics was my favorite subject in high school.
The news isn't good, I'm afraid.

2. Has it ever taken you a long time / long time to find a job?
3. Do you have an experience / experience preparing a resume?

5. Do / Does economics give people useful knowledge for a career in business?
6. Have you ever thought of starting a business / business?
7. Do you think that politics interest / interests young people as a career?
